name: Vermont

obligations.title: Annual Reports
obligations.applies_when: Profit corporations, profit cooperative corporations, and limited liability companies (LLC/PLC/L3C).
obligations.due_rule: Within the first two and a half months after fiscal year end for profit corporations, or three months for LLC/PLC/L3C.
obligations.quote: As a profit corporation, profit cooperative corporation, or a limited liability company (LLC/PLC/L3C), you must renew your business registration each fiscal year by filing an annual report within the first two and a half months (Profit Corps.) or three months (LLC/PLC/L3C) following the fiscal year end on record.
